reached_sql:
SELECT 
    i_item_id AS item_id,
    i_item_desc AS item_description,
    s_store_id AS store_id,
    s_store_name AS store_name,
    MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number, d1.d_date_sk
     FROM 
        store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
     WHERE 
        d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999) AS sales_data
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_ticket_number, d2.d_date_sk
     FROM 
        store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
     WHERE 
        d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999) AS returns_data
ON 
    sales_data.ss_customer_sk = returns_data.sr_customer_sk AND sales_data.ss_item_sk = returns_data.sr_item_sk AND sales_data.ss_ticket_number = returns_data.sr_ticket_number
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, d3.d_date_sk
     FROM 
        catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
     WHERE 
        d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999) AS sales_data2
ON 
    returns_data.sr_customer_sk = sales_data2.cs_bill_customer_sk AND returns_data.sr_item_sk = sales_data2.cs_item_sk
JOIN 
    store ON store.s_store_sk = (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk)
JOIN 
    item ON item.i_item_sk = (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk)
GROUP BY 
    i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
